sections.title: Sidequests
sections.note: Optional quests, shops and minigames with a lasting reward. Pieces of Heart, Poes, Golden Bugs and Hidden Skills have their own trackers.

items.name: Talo's target practice
items.howTo: Talk to Talo on the lookout and hit the three targets around the village with the Hero's Bow.
items.reward: Piece of Heart; the Hawkeye goes on sale at Malo Mart (100 Rupees)
items.notes: The Piece of Heart is also in the Heart Pieces tracker.

items.name: Iza's blocked river
items.area: Iza's Boat Rental, Upper Zora's River
items.howTo: Iza lends you a Bomb Bag. Blow up the boulders at her cabin and then down the river with Bomb Arrows from the canoe.

items.name: Iza's Rapid Ride
items.area: Iza's Boat Rental, Upper Zora's River
items.howTo: Pay 20 Rupees and ride the rapids to Lake Hylia shooting jars with Bomb Arrows: yellow +1, red +2, -1 per bump. Score 25 or more.
items.reward: Giant Bomb Bag (doubles every bomb bag)

items.name: Sinking Lure
items.area: Hena's Fishing Hole, Upper Zora's River
items.howTo: After catching a Hyrule Bass, an Ordon Catfish and a Hylian Pike by lure fishing (canoe, 20 Rupees), the lure shows up at the highest point of the east bank or the west end of the south bank. Reel it in with the Fishing Rod.
items.notes: Hena says sinking lures are banned; she notices if you use it.

items.name: Rollgoal
items.howTo: Look at the board beside the door in first person and play for 5 Rupees a try: tilt it to roll the ball to the goal in time. Each level cleared pays 10 Rupees; a new layout is ready each time you re-enter the hut.

tiers.name: All 64 levels
tiers.reward: Rupees to fill your wallet, then free special-edition Rollgoal

items.notes: 8 layouts at 8 difficulties. Time limits: GameCube 2:00 at difficulty 1 down to 0:30; Wii and HD 3:00 down to 0:40.

items.name: Charlo's donations
items.area: Castle Town, west road by the goat pens
items.howTo: Donate 30 or 50 Rupees at a time to the beggar Charlo until you have given 1,000 in all.
items.notes: The Piece of Heart is also in the Heart Pieces tracker.

items.name: STAR Game
items.howTo: Pay Purlo 10 Rupees and grab every glowing orb in the cage before time runs out, Clawshotting between the ceiling grates.

items.name: Malo Mart: bridge donation
items.howTo: Gor Ebizo at Malo Mart asks for donations to the townspeople-relief plan. Give 1,000 Rupees in total to repair the bridge to Castle Town's east gate.
items.reward: The bridge east of Castle Town is repaired

items.name: Hot springwater delivery
items.area: Kakariko Village to the bridge east of Castle Town
items.howTo: Talk to the worn-out Goron at the repaired bridge, then get a barrel of hot springwater from Gor Liggs in Kakariko and carry it across the field without being hit. Throw it on the Goron.
items.reward: Piece of Heart; the next donation drops from 2,000 to 200 Rupees
items.notes: Optional, but it saves 1,800 Rupees. The Piece of Heart is also in the Heart Pieces tracker.

items.name: Malo Mart: Castle Town branch
items.howTo: Donate the rest at Kakariko Malo Mart: 200 Rupees after the hot springwater delivery, 2,000 without it. Malo Mart buys Chudley's Emporium in Castle Town; the Postman's letter "Heroes, Come Together" announces the opening.

items.name: Snowboard races with Yeto and Yeta
items.area: Snowpeak summit down to Snowpeak Ruins
items.howTo: Warp to Snowpeak's summit and talk to Yeto to race him down to the mansion on your shield. Beat him, then race Yeta.
items.notes: Yeta's letter "From Wife of Yeto" invites you back. The Piece of Heart is also in the Heart Pieces tracker.

items.name: STAR Game: Double Clawshot round
items.howTo: Purlo's harder round (15 Rupees): collect every orb within 1:30, swinging between grates with the Double Clawshots. Afterwards a time trial against your best time is open.
items.notes: Purlo's letter "Challenge for You" announces it.

sections.title: Letters
sections.note: The Postman delivers 16 letters, only in Hyrule Field, on your next visit after each trigger. The menu keeps the order they arrive in.

items.name: Post Office Notice
items.howTo: From the Postman himself, on your first trip across Hyrule Field toward the Eldin twilight wall.

items.name: DEAR ADVENTURER
items.howTo: From Ooccoo. Arrives after a dungeon in which you met Ooccoo but never used her, normally the Forest Temple.
items.notes: Lost for good if you use Ooccoo in the first dungeon you meet her: using her introduces Ooccoo Jr. and you get "Dear Adventurer (2)" instead. To get both, pick her up but don't use her in the Forest Temple.

items.name: URGENT NOTICE
items.howTo: From Kakariko Goods (Malo Mart): the Kakariko shop's grand opening, with the Hylian Shield as its exclusive. Arrives once Colin is rescued from King Bulblin.

items.name: URGENT: Bomb Arrows
items.howTo: From Barnes Bombs, explaining Bomb Arrows; sent after you buy your first Bomb Bag from Barnes.

items.name: Good Stuff Inside
items.howTo: From Barnes Bombs: Water Bombs are now in stock. Arrives once the Lanayru spirit is restored.

items.name: Now Open for Business
items.howTo: From Lanayru Tourism, advertising Iza's Rapid Ride and Hena's Fishing Hole. Arrives with "Good Stuff Inside".

items.name: They Came So Quickly!
items.area: Hyrule Field, bridge to Castle Town
items.howTo: From Telma, asking you to come to her bar to meet the Resistance.

items.name: Dear Adventurer (2)
items.howTo: From Ooccoo. Arrives after a dungeon in which you used Ooccoo and so met her son.
items.notes: Use Ooccoo at least once by the Temple of Time (sources differ: Snowpeak Ruins is the safe deadline); by the City in the Sky she has gone home. Its place in the list depends on when you first use her.

items.name: Rare Item in Stock
items.area: Hyrule Field, bridge to Castle Town
items.howTo: From Barnes: Bomblings are now in stock.

items.name: Agitha's Dream
items.howTo: From Agitha. Arrives after the Snowpeak Ruins if you have given her at least one Golden Bug.
items.notes: The one-bug condition comes from the Zelda Dungeon wiki only.

items.name: From Wife of Yeto
items.howTo: From Yeta, inviting you back to Snowpeak (the snowboard races).

items.name: Heroes, Come Together
items.howTo: From Malo Mart: the Castle Town branch's grand opening, with the Magic Armor as its special. Arrives after the last Malo Mart donation.
items.notes: Only if you do the optional Malo Mart donations.

items.name: About Ilia's Memory
items.area: Hyrule Field, bridge to Castle Town
items.howTo: From Renado, about a way to bring back Ilia's memory.

items.name: Update
items.howTo: From Shad, once all six Sky Characters are restored to the Ancient Sky Book.

items.name: Challenge for You
items.howTo: From Purlo: the new Double Clawshot round of the STAR Game is open.

items.name: Hey Kid!!!
items.howTo: From Jr. (Ooccoo Jr.), with a note from Ooccoo, after the City in the Sky. Arrives with Purlo's letter.

sections.title: Fishing Journal
sections.note: Only fish caught with your own Fishing Rod are logged; lure catches at the Fishing Hole, Skullfish and Bombfish are not.

items.name: Greengill
items.howTo: The most common fish; the first one you catch in Ordon Village for Sera's cat counts.

items.name: Ordon Catfish
items.howTo: In Ordon Village's stream and pond; also near the rock arch in the middle of Hena's Fishing Hole.

items.name: Hyrule Bass
items.area: Kakariko Graveyard lake and Eldin Spring
items.howTo: In the lake behind Kakariko Graveyard or behind Eldin Spring; also the southeast corner of Hena's Fishing Hole, nearest the hut.

items.name: Hylian Loach
items.howTo: Young loaches bite your rod in the grotto by the Lake Hylia Howling Stone, the grass-circle grotto in the Faron field, the Kakariko spring where the Zora Armor is, and Lanayru Spring.
items.notes: A full-size loach is only caught by lure fishing in summer at the Fishing Hole, so it goes in Hena's tank, not the journal.

items.name: Hylian Pike
items.area: South of Castle Town and Hena's Fishing Hole
items.howTo: Dig on top of the tall pillar circled by birds south of Castle Town to reach a grotto spring full of pike. Also near the shore at Hena's Fishing Hole.

items.name: Reekfish
items.howTo: Fit Prince Ralis' Coral Earring to your rod and fish by the Mother-and-Child Rocks in the waterfall basin below Zora's Domain.
items.notes: Required to find the way up Snowpeak by its scent.

sections.title: HD Stamps
sections.note: Twilight Princess HD only: 50 Miiverse stamps, mostly in chests that held Rupees in the original.

items.name: Hylian Letter A
items.howTo: In the room with the Big Key, take the passage at water level to the south to a chest.

items.name: Hylian Letter N
items.howTo: In the room with the Tile Worms (and the Piece of Heart), in a raised chest.

items.name: Hylian Letter H
items.area: Second floor, big room full of Bulblin Archers
items.howTo: In the large room with many archers, sink with the Iron Boots to the underwater chest on the east side.

items.name: Hylian Letter O
items.howTo: Bomb open the cave south-east of the Kakariko Gorge bridge (the one with a Poe). The chest is in the north, beside a Skulltula: north, then north-west at the forks.

items.name: Hylian Letter J
items.howTo: In the long dark cave up the ladder in the south of Lake Hylia, go east, east, north, east at the forks and light the two torches to make the chest appear.
items.notes: Fork directions from Zelda's Palace (HD Normal Mode).

items.name: Treasure Chest
items.howTo: In the same cave, go east, east, north, west, west, west, north, south, east and bomb the rock to the east next to the last room.
items.notes: Zelda's Palace calls it the Hylian Chest stamp.

items.name: Cucco
items.howTo: One of the Flight-by-Fowl prize chests (the one that held a Purple Rupee).

items.name: Hylian Letter K
items.howTo: In the central room's basement, just below the door to the boss, after you first make the water flow.

items.name: Hylian Letter Y
items.area: Top floor, where you first made the water flow
items.howTo: Clawshot up the wall where you first set the water flowing to reach the chest.

items.name: Hylian Letter U
items.howTo: From the Letter H chest, climb the ladder, go east and look north. Clawshot the iron grate and climb it to the chest.

items.name: Malo Mart
items.howTo: Buy it for 50 Rupees once the Castle Town Malo Mart opens.

items.name: Wolf Link
items.howTo: From the Horse Grass in the south of Faron Field, follow the wall east to some tall grass and dig as a wolf into a hidden cave.

items.name: Happy Link
items.howTo: By day, go into the barn at Ordon Ranch, dig as a wolf where your senses show, and light the two torches in the grotto.

items.name: Hylian Letter C
items.area: Hyrule Field (Eldin), grotto by the highest hill
items.howTo: In the field with the wild boars, near the highest hill (north-west of the biggest pool), dig as a wolf in the bare patch inside the grass and light the two torches.

items.name: Angry Link
items.area: Hyrule Field west of Castle Town, grotto
items.howTo: North-west of Castle Town's west gate, dig as a wolf inside the ring of stones (where the female Golden Butterfly is).

items.name: Hylian Letter I
items.area: Hyrule Field north of Castle Town, grotto
items.howTo: North of the castle, on the east bank, dig as a wolf in the grass ring to the south near the water.

items.name: Hylian Letter P
items.area: Hyrule Field north of Castle Town, grotto by the river tunnel
items.howTo: In the far north where the river comes out of a tunnel, dig as a wolf in the grass ring on the east shore. Beat the spiders and light the three torches.

items.name: Hylian Letter F
items.area: Hyrule Field north of Castle Town, by the castle wall
items.howTo: North of Hyrule Castle, in a cage in the water against the castle, reached from above.

items.name: Hylian Letter S
items.area: Lake Hylia, grotto by the watchtower
items.howTo: In the south-west, climb the ladder to the watchtower, go on a little and dig where your senses show. Clear out the frogs to open the chest.

items.name: Hylian Letter M
items.area: Grotto on the crag below the Great Bridge of Hylia
items.howTo: On the road with the fire-arrow archers, Bomb-Arrow the high rocks and Clawshot up the targets (where a Poe floats), then dig as a wolf and beat the skeletons.

items.name: Hylian Letter W
items.howTo: From the Lake Hylia portal take the path towards the Poe's platform; jump into the water and put on the Iron Boots just before landing on the platform with the chest.
items.notes: Only Zelda's Palace describes this one, and vaguely.

items.name: Hylian Letter R
items.area: North-west of the Cave of Ordeals
items.howTo: From the Cave of Ordeals entrance go north-west, Clawshot onto the flying Peahat plant and let go at the far west, by the chest.

items.name: Sad Midna
items.howTo: In the grotto under the ring of three skulls (two Poes), beat the Poes, destroy the rock and light the three torches.

items.name: Hylian Letter D
items.howTo: Soon after getting the Spinner, ride the rails up the large room; in its second part, open the chest guarded by two Stalfos.

items.name: Surprised Midna
items.area: First floor, chandelier room after the third Poe
items.howTo: Raise the chandelier with the mechanism, then cross quickly while it's at the ceiling and open the chest.

items.name: Piece of Heart
items.howTo: In the cave north of the Bridge of Eldin, light the two torches just before the Piece of Heart chest.
items.after: After the Bridge of Eldin is restored

items.name: Sad Link
items.area: Hyrule Field (Eldin), grotto by the Bridge of Eldin
items.howTo: Near the Bridge of Eldin, dig as a wolf on the left as you come off the bridge.
items.after: After the Bridge of Eldin is restored

items.name: Surprised Zelda
items.area: Hyrule Field below Castle Town's south gate
items.howTo: Clawshot the pillar to the north-west of the south gate, let go, ride the Spinner and jump a little before halfway to land by the fountain chest.

items.name: Agitha
items.howTo: Give Agitha 12 Golden Bugs.

items.name: Surprised Link
items.howTo: Reach the Great Fairy on floor 10; the stamp is by her door.
items.after: After the Bridge of Eldin is restored

items.name: Angry Zelda
items.howTo: Reach the Great Fairy on floor 20; the stamp is by her door.
items.after: After the Bridge of Eldin is restored

items.name: Hylian Letter B
items.area: First floor, beam room past the first cannon
items.howTo: Shortly after clearing the way with the first cannon, in the room where you walk on beams.

items.name: Hylian Letter Q
items.howTo: Behind a suit of armour in the hall that you smash completely with the Ball and Chain.

items.name: Happy Midna
items.howTo: Reach the Great Fairy on floor 30; the stamp is by her door.
items.after: After the Bridge of Eldin is restored

items.name: Hylian Letter X
items.area: Sacred Grove, the Lost Woods maze
items.howTo: Next to the statue clearing, climb the vine wall into the maze, then ride the Spinner almost all the way round to the platform with the chest.

items.name: Hylian Letter L
items.howTo: In the room with the spiders (where a Piece of Heart needs the Dominion Rod), in the chest at the back.

items.name: Hylian Letter T
items.howTo: Use the scales to Clawshot higher, then the Spinner to reach the chest just behind the Poe.

items.name: Hylian Letter E
items.howTo: In the field with the small bridge before Kakariko, use the Dominion Rod on the Owl Statue to reach the high chest.
items.after: Once the Dominion Rod's power is restored

items.name: Heart Container
items.howTo: Reach the Great Fairy on floor 40; the stamp is by her door.
items.after: After the Bridge of Eldin is restored

items.name: Hylian Letter G
items.area: Second floor, outdoor room with flying plants
items.howTo: Cross the outdoor room on the flying plants; the chest is where a Poe also floats.

items.name: Hylian Letter Z
items.area: Fourth floor, outdoor room with ropes
items.howTo: In the chest by the Poe in the outdoor room with ropes.

items.name: Ooccoo
items.howTo: In the west rooms where you climb up and down with targets and iron grates, turn round before going on to the Big Baba room.

items.name: Hylian Letter V
items.area: Hyrule Field, the chasm below Castle Town's south stairs
items.howTo: At the foot of the stairs south of Castle Town, follow the Clawshot targets over the drop towards Lake Hylia; the chest is by the fourth target.

items.name: Fairy
items.howTo: On the small landing at the end of floor 49, just before you drop into the Great Fairy's room.

items.name: Angry Midna
items.howTo: In the first room whose fog turns you into a wolf, Clawshot up after beating Zant's Hand.

items.name: Zant
items.area: First floor, second room on the right
items.howTo: Clawshot along the high targets and check the recesses on your left.

items.name: Happy Zelda
items.area: Treasure room next to the boss door
items.howTo: In the room of treasure chests beside the door to the boss.
items.notes: In the original this chest held 50 Slingshot seeds.

items.name: Sad Zelda
items.howTo: After the Dungeon Map, climb the ladder to the right of its chest and follow the path to the end.

items.name: Rupee
items.howTo: After all 60 Poe Souls, find Jovani in Telma's Bar, then go back to Gengle: he gives you 200 Rupees and this stamp.

items.name: Twili Midna
items.howTo: Unlocked automatically once you have the other 49 stamps.
